validity_findings: Part A harness build & unit test: PASS on attempt 2. The attempt-1 failure (all_eight_counter_paths_nonzero=false because repair=0) was a legitimate implementation defect in staleness injection (bumping bare rids while substrate serves ep-a: keys). The fix mirrors the parent packet's own bump call exactly. No gate, threshold, statistic, or control was changed between attempts. Attempt 1 is fully archived; attempt 2 is the reporting attempt. Unit tests: 39 tests, exit 0, all pass, covering each arm, each counter, hard reset, UNKNOWN gate, no-fill behavior, bootstrap/permutation, f* and sensitivity. Zero surrogate/default fills confirmed.

Part B dry-run on certified substrate: PASS. Health gate passes all frozen criteria: n_non304=400 stratified (200/endpoint ≥180), TN_fresh=1.0 (≥0.85), HS256, WAL, nginx sticky, single worker, ETag W/"body_sha" seen. All 5 arms × 192 trajectories = 960 records. All 8 counters recorded per trajectory for EXECUTABLE arms. Family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap B=5000 and block-permutation B=5000 compute without error (seed=42). UNKNOWN gates fire correctly for live_browser mode (all 5 arms UNKNOWN with counters=null, payload_bytes=null, missing=[browsergym, playwright, policy_model]); scripted mode EXECUTABLE. Zero crashes, zero transport errors, zero integrity failures, zero surrogate fills, zero default fills. Result.json explicitly discloses 'instrument correctness ONLY — not a scientific or product result'.

Part C break-even reuse count f*: PASS. Primary unit = bytes (the only identifiable unit on this substrate). f*_bytes = 36.7001, formula f* = (build_cost + verify_cost) / (serving_cost_cold - serving_cost_inherited) with measured inputs: build_cost=35027 bytes (harvest_payload_bytes), verify_cost=0 bytes (probe_payload_bytes, all 36 probes 304), serving_cost_cold=971.099 bytes/trajectory, serving_cost_inherited=16.688 bytes/trajectory. Post-hoc paired family-stratified bootstrap CI for f*: [34.57, 39.15] (denominator CI [894.63, 1013.17] bytes, strictly positive). OAT ±10% sensitivity identifies cold_serving_cost as dominant quantity (max |rel change| 0.113), above build_cost (0.100), inherited_serving_cost (0.002), verify_cost (0.000). Token economics correctly NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN — no token parameter exists by construction.

f*_latency_ms is NOT IDENTIFIABLE on this single-node localhost substrate: serving denominator (cold - inherited) CI spans zero in both attempts (attempt 1: +0.115 ms, CI [-0.719, 1.005]; attempt 2: -0.531 ms, CI [-1.234, 0.200]). This is expected — 304 body suppression saves bytes but not measurable round-trip time on localhost. Any time-domain amortization claim must be re-measured on a WAN-like substrate.

f*_bytes is substrate- and content-bound: measures protocol-level payload saving (971.1 B cold vs 16.7 B inherited per trajectory via 304 revalidation on localhost). It does not measure wall-clock, token, or monetary saving. The mapping from bytes-saved to time/money-saved outside localhost is unresolved.

B-RAG-EMBED arm's frozen spec text ('200 token retrieval + 150ms verify cost model') was NOT instantiated — token economics are frozen NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN and measurement_validity forbids synthetic jitter/proxies. The RAG arm charges honest measured local retrieval time only. This affects only latency cross-arm interpretation, not the eight-counter gates, payload/requests CIs, or f* (which uses bytes as primary unit).

NC-SHUFFLED-FAMILY-STRATIFIED: frozen sentence is genuinely ambiguous ('Shuffled rho_shuffled and rho_length must satisfy |rho|<0.20 per stratum'). Both defensible readings evaluated and reported separately: (a) shuffled-null reading PASS (rho_shuffled median -0.0045, per-stratum shuffled rho_length all |rho|<0.02, block_permutation p=0.972); (b) observed-rho reading FAIL in 3/5 strata (attempt 2: strata 0.0 rho=0.382 n=45 perm_p=0.009, 0.5 rho=0.269 n=42 p=0.084, 0.6667 rho=0.268 n=21 p=0.23; attempt 1 failed different strata with opposite signs: 0.3333 rho=-0.481, 0.6667 rho=-0.492). Cross-attempt sign instability and the fact that latency_ms is measured (not formula-derived) argue against deterministic counter-formula coupling, but the literal observed-data gate failure stands as recorded. Controls are NOT part of the frozen decision_rule.overall; the MIXED result is disclosed and bounds interpretation.

B-INSTRUCTIONS: Static instructions baseline. 192/192 executed. Identical request count to B-COLD (2092) — this is the reference arm for the NC statistic (Delta = latency_ms(B-INSTRUCTIONS) - latency_ms(B-COLD) per trajectory). Paired latency delta vs COLD observed_mean=0.229 ms, bootstrap CI [-0.497, 1.477] spans 0, confirming the statistic is measurement noise under the null.

B-RAG-EMBED: TF-IDF retrieval TAU=0.30, QCR k=5 with honest counters. 192/192 executed. resolve=192, bind=384, requests=2092. Payload_bytes_total=186451 (no payload saving vs COLD because retrieval does not change request pattern on this substrate). Latency_ms=4783 (honest local retrieval time; frozen '150ms verify cost model' not instantiated per validity note).

B-DETERMINISTIC-EXECUTOR: No-memory deterministic compiled executor (Frontier's null against SPIDER's premise). 192/192 executed. bind=384, resolve=0, freshness=0, repair=0, requests=2092. Payload_bytes_total=186451. Paired payload delta vs P-SPIDER identical to COLD's (CI [894.63, 1013.17], p=0.0002), confirming payload saving is entirely from 304 body suppression, not from compilation bypass.
